FN-6FO813-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 434
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/17/2023
House Bill 434 as introduced could increase or decrease the cost of certain public works
projects by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in the cost of: (1) domestic
timber, required to be used pursuant to this bill; and (2) the timber otherwise purchased for such
project under current law.
